_description: Qwen3.8 — local 27B fleet arm (HyperQwen patched vLLM) for agentic tool-calling workloads; the default local executor in UAP routing since the 2026-11-19 arm swap (successor in that slot to the strata/speedy Flash-Next serve layer, itself successor to qwen36 and the 2026-09-20 GSQ-RCO llama.cpp deployment — those arms stay panel-switchable). Routes through the anthropic-proxy for the tool/finalize guardrails, NOT the inference server directly.
_engine: HyperQwen fleet server on :8080 (syv-ai/HyperQwen patched vLLM 0.33.0), live since 2026-11-19 behind the systemd user unit uap-hyperqwen-server.service, serving Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound-fast (W4A16 AutoRound quant, --gpu-memory-utilization 0.87, --max-model-len 118784, --kv-cache-dtype int8_per_token_head, MTP speculative k=3 with probabilistic draft sampling, prefix caching on, --reasoning-parser qwen3 + --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder with auto tool choice, Qwen-Sharp chat template, --language-model-only: NO vision on this arm). Serves OpenAI-shaped /v1 (chat/completions, models) plus Prometheus /metrics; the llama.cpp-shaped /props and /slots and the strata JSON /metrics are absent on this engine — the sync's MODELS_ONLY probe and the rails live-chain both fall back to /v1/models for the alias. vLLM ENFORCES the served model id on the direct route: only qwen3.8-27b is accepted (404 otherwise — fleet log 2026-11-19 18:39:37), so direct-path clients must send exactly the profile's model field; the :4000 proxy maps every id onto the backend regardless. Measured 2026-11-19 (fleet log + live probes): 82.7 tok/s fresh decode (400 tokens / 4.835 s), 69.4 tok/s at a 101728-token prompt depth (1000 tokens / 14.40 s), MTP per-position acceptance 0.869/0.686/0.577 (mean acceptance length 2.52-3.13, avg draft acceptance 50.8-71.7%), prefix cache hit rate 54%.

The speedy/strata flash-next units stay installed and panel-switchable — on a switch back, restore this profile's model field and _engine the same day (the rails suite drift-checks both). SUPERSEDED 2026-10-04: this profile described buun-llama-cpp behind uap-gsq-rco-server.service (2 rails sharing a 229376-cell VBR pool, DFlash2 draft). That unit is now INACTIVE — the box serves the Strata layer on :8080 instead (tuned 2026-10-03: +15% over the llama.cpp fork on agent workloads). The old description was itself a 2026-09-20 correction of a ninfer-serve description. Verify against /metrics before trusting engine claims here; the dead unit's ExecStart still reports -c 229376 to systemctl, and on 2026-10-04 `uap inference health` printed that stale pool size for the live (131072) backend.

The server ignores requested model ids, so clients pinning the old id are unaffected; on revert, restore this field alongside the unit's --config. 2026-10-28: the unit default moved to the DavidAU abliterated IQ2_XS arm (uap-strata-server -> strata-abliterated-iq2_xs.json), so the live alias is abliterated-iq2_xs; UNLIKE every flash-next arm before it (whose engines ignored requested model ids), this engine ENFORCES the served alias on the direct route — vLLM answers 404 for any other id (fleet log 2026-11-19 18:39:37), which is exactly why the direct-path client entries must carry this field's value; through the :4000 proxy every id still maps (FALLBACK_LOCAL_MODEL_ID). The speedy/strata flash-next arms stay switchable via the panel — on a switch back, restore this field the same day.
_max_tokens_comment: Deliberately generous: 50% of the 114688 window, the same ratio the 90112/180224 and 65536/131072 pairings before it used. The engine returns chain-of-thought in a SEPARATE reasoning_content field, so reasoning spends completion budget without ever appearing in content. A tight cap therefore does not produce a short answer, it produces an EMPTY one with finish_reason=length — measured previously as ~90% first-turn decode failure that read as bad output format and was really budget truncation. Do not lower this without re-measuring decode compliance. (The proxy additionally clamps tool turns to PROXY_TOOL_TURN_MAX_TOKENS=32768 regardless.)
_sampling_comment: Carried over from qwen36 unchanged: these are UAP's tool-call-tuned values, not the vendor's chat defaults. They were re-measured only against the llama.cpp GSQ-RCO engine, never against strata — and never against the HyperQwen vLLM arm either (carried unchanged through the 2026-11-19 arm swap); strata's own defaults (spec 12, spec-min-p 0.5) affect drafting, not base sampling, so the values are carried as-is. Re-tune with `uap tune` before changing them.
_context_window_comment: THIS IS A PER-SESSION CAP, AND IT IS LOAD-BEARING. The HyperQwen vLLM arm serves ONE rail with a 131072-cell pool (a fixed 4.49 GiB KV budget at int8-per-token-head; --max-model-len 118784 caps a single REQUEST at 118784 — the proxy's margin math keeps request totals at or under 111412, safely under that ceiling; the speedy/strata flash-next arms are down since the 2026-11-19 arm swap, and their 196608 pool returns with a panel switch back); the proxy's detection reads slots[0].n_ctx, and with /slots unreachable on this engine the PROXY_CONTEXT_WINDOW fallback (114688) HOLDS — the cap is enforced by the fallback instead of being overwritten by detection. 114688 deliberately sits BELOW the pool: the difference (16384 cells, the same engine-margin convention the 65536/131072 pairing used) is the engine's own working room (prompt scratch, conversation cache, expert-cache bookkeeping), so a session at the cap cannot crowd the engine out of its own pool. Admission stays 1: two hot sessions at this cap would demand 229376 cells from a 131072-cell pool, the exact overcommit the per-session cap exists to prevent. In practice sessions sit below it: the proxy prunes at 0.80 (~92k) toward 0.66 (~76k) — the operator band for the 114688 posture (the 180224 era ran 0.80 toward 0.70); the compaction invariant in test/model-profiles-qwen38-rails.test.ts pins the band that ships with THIS window. IMPORTANT GAP (unchanged from the llama.cpp era): this cap is OPT-IN. A client that does not send the x-uap-model-profile header gets the whole pool. opencode, codex and claude-local send it; factory/droid custom models cannot, so keep factory to one local session at a time. /v1/models advertises the process-wide window (131072), not this cap.
_thinking_comment: Top-level. The proxy probes the backend once and adapts (PROXY_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS=auto|on|off), so the top-level enable_thinking form remains correct across the llama.cpp, strata and HyperQwen vLLM backends (the vLLM arm runs --reasoning-parser qwen3, the same separation).

dynamic_temperature._comment: On retry, temp = max(floor, base_temp * decay^attempt). Reduces randomness for structured output.

tool_call_batching.system_prompt_suffix: When multiple tools are needed, call ALL of them in a single response. Do not call one tool and wait - emit all tool calls together.
tool_call_batching._comment: Reduces round-trips by encouraging multi-tool emission in one turn.

concurrency._comment: The HyperQwen vLLM arm runs ONE rail with a 131072-cell pool (live since the 2026-11-19 arm swap; the strata flash-next arms run their own pools when switched back — the 196608 #918 pool reclaims the 180224 single-session window). Request concurrency stays with the rail: PROXY_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT=1, UAP_MODEL_SLOTS=1 (the move-together rule). SESSION ADMISSION is different and now defaults 4 everywhere (operator decision 2026-11-18, the 2026-11-17 queue-depth override made durable): scripts/sync-local-agent-configs.sh installs PROXY_SESSION_ADMISSION_LIMIT=4 and the proxy runtime fallback is 4, so it survives every sync. The arithmetic overcommit (4 hot sessions x 114688 = 458752 cells demanded of the 131072 pool) is operator-accepted: admission is a queue-depth knob, idle sessions prune at the 90s TTL and waiters force-admit at 300s by evicting the LRU admission, so contention degrades to queueing, not pool corruption. Mission-deliver runs no longer serialize behind one hot session.
concurrency._kv_shared_comment: One rail, one pool: trivially shared, and still true that a rail addresses the WHOLE pool rather than owning a slice. Kept true so consumers that branch on it keep treating the pool as a shared resource.

server_optimization._kv_dtype_comment: int8-class KV: this arm runs --kv-cache-dtype int8_per_token_head (per-token-head int8 quantization) on a fixed 4.49 GiB KV budget (kv-cache-memory 4819457484 bytes) — no VBR floor to pin, no resident-cell tier; vLLM manages pressure with its own block eviction plus the prefix cache. The profile's job is only to keep the per-session cap below the pool.
server_optimization._capacity_comment: Whole pool, one rail (131072 — the speedy-base fork arm live since 2026-11-18; the strata arms serve the 196608 #918 raise, reclaim it by switching arms). Per-session allowance is context_window above (114688, deliberately under the pool by the same 16384-cell engine margin).

speculative_decoding._comment: 2026-11-19: the serving arm is the HyperQwen vLLM 27B fleet arm (uap-hyperqwen-server), drafting with the model's OWN MTP head in-engine — --speculative-config {method mtp, num_speculative_tokens 3, draft_sample_method probabilistic}; there is NO external draft artifact on this arm (draft_model is empty by reality, not omission — the strata-data/mtp/rt path belongs to the flash-next arms and returns with a panel switch back), and probabilistic draft sampling exposes no confidence floor (draft_conf null). Measured 2026-11-19 (fleet SpecDecoding metrics on live agent traffic): per-position acceptance 0.869/0.686/0.577, mean acceptance length 2.52-3.13, avg draft acceptance 50.8-71.7% — the k=3 third position still pays. The strata/speedy flash-next arms draft at spec 8-12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8 (the v31 arm before them at spec 12 / 0.50 / mtp_max 4); update this pin on every arm switch. The DFlash2 flip did NOT hold anywhere: the auto plan for this model class (spec 6 / conf 0.7, the tuned strata1 pack) OOM-killed the engine at start twice on 2026-11-11 and the serve wrapper's DIDNT_START fallback landed on MTP; sm_86 is also the card class where upstream measured DFlash2 slower than MTP (strata_control/drafting.py _SLOWER) and this box's own 2026-10-28 A/B rejected the stock drafter (-5.5% mean decode, bench/results/2026-10-28-dflash2-vs-mtp). A DFlash2 retry needs a smaller RAM budget and a fresh measured A/B — it stays documentation, never a live value here. The 2026-10-04 acceptance figure in `measured` predates every drafter here: re-measure on real agent traffic before quoting a number.

server_optimization._comment: These are the flags the serve units actually run with, recorded so a rebuild reproduces the measured behaviour. The load-bearing pair (kv int8, max-context 131072 on the speedy-base arm) is pinned in config/capacity-policy.json under the strata-server http entry, where `uap doctor` verifies them against /metrics. 2026-11-19: the serving arm is the HyperQwen vLLM arm — its load-bearing numbers live in the model registry's qwen3.8-27b hyperqwen config (pool 131072 / cap 114688 / int8-per-token-head KV), hand-measured same-day; the capacity-policy strata-server entry correctly reads DARK while the strata arms are down, and `uap doctor` / `uap models measure` do not yet speak vLLM's Prometheus /metrics (board-flagged follow-up).

measured._arm_comment: 2026-11-19: the HyperQwen vLLM 27B arm is RE-MEASURED FRESH, not carried — decode 82.7 tok/s on a 400-token fresh burst (4.835 s) and 69.4 tok/s at a 101728-token prompt depth (1000 tokens / 14.40 s); MTP avg draft acceptance 50.8-71.7% (per-position 0.869/0.686/0.577), prefix cache hit rate 54%; prefill not decomposable from the engine's per-request elapsed figures, so prefill_tokens_per_second is null on this arm. The strata-era history below (all flash-next arms) is HISTORY now — do not quote it for the 27B arm. The figures below were measured 2026-10-04 on the pre-arm-swap strata base pack (IQ3_S-era weights). The 2026-11-11 move to the unsloth UD-IQ4_XS v3.1 arm, the 2026-11-13 switch to the abliterated arm and the 2026-11-14 revert to the v31 arm all keep the engine, the 131072 pool and the int8 KV tier, so they carry as estimates; the drafting numbers differ per arm (v31: spec 12 / 0.50 / mtp_max 4; abliterated: spec 12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8 — recorded in server_optimization), and decode/acceptance on THIS arm were never re-measured (uap tune / scripts/bench-decode-reps.sh) before quoting them as its figures. 2026-11-17: the ISTA-DASLab base IQ3_S arm (drafting spec 12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8, recorded in server_optimization) keeps the engine, pool and KV tier too — switch-day smoke only (clean tool-call turn, ~60 tok/s cold first request, draft acceptance 42/65 = 0.65 cold, warming); no formal re-measure on it yet. 2026-11-17 (evening): the operator-directed pool raise to 196608 (per-session window 180224) changes neither the engine nor the KV tier, so these figures carry as estimates unchanged; KV beyond the 32768 resident cells pages via SSD-backed PLE exactly as it already did beyond 131072. 2026-11-17 (evening): the DavidAU abliterated IQ3_S arm REINSTATED as the default (same engine, same 196608 pool, int8 KV; drafting spec 12 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8 unchanged) - figures still carry as estimates; decode/acceptance never re-measured on this arm either. 2026-11-18: the IQ3_S-only panel round moved :8080 to the Speedy-fork ISTA base arm (uap-speedy-base-iq3s-server, engine 0.1.53, 131072 pool, spec 8 / 0.70 / mtp_max 8) — the engine line, pool size and draft window all differ from every arm above, so the figures below carry as LOOSE estimates on this arm until re-measured; switch-day smoke: clean boot, /metrics healthy, no decode re-measure yet.
measured._gpu_comment: 2026-11-19 (HyperQwen arm): nvidia-smi compute apps shows the service's EngineCore at 20202 MiB of the 24576 MiB card (gpu-memory-utilization 0.87 cap, ~3.4 GiB headroom); host-side the unit's cgroup sits at 5.3G current, 19.1G peak. The strata reserve-aware /metrics view is gone with that arm.
measured._decode_comment: 2026-11-19 (HyperQwen vLLM 27B arm), measured live against :8080: 82.7 tok/s on a fresh 400-token generation (4.835 s, 182-token prompt, temp 0.7) and 69.4 tok/s at a 101728-token prompt depth (1000 tokens / 14.40 s, ~47k uncached prefill at 54% prefix-cache hit inside the same elapsed window). Depth matters as much as workload — quote the PAIR, never one number. For scale: the strata flash-next arms ran 36-52 tok/s at depth, and the 2026-11-18 llama external-draft arm ran 18-19.4 tok/s; this arm is 1.3-2x the former and ~4x the latter.
measured._draft_acceptance_comment: 2026-11-19 (HyperQwen MTP k=3, live SpecDecoding metrics over real agent traffic): avg draft acceptance 50.8-71.7% across 10 s windows, per-position acceptance 0.869/0.686/0.577, mean acceptance length 2.52-3.13 — the k=3 third position still pays at 0.577. The field carries the best-window 71.7%; the strata-era 0.84 and the prior engine's counting-prompt 0.90 are history.
measured._prefill_comment: 2026-11-19: null on this arm — vLLM reports per-request elapsed only, so prefill cannot be decomposed from generation inside elapsed_s, and the engine's prompt-throughput window averages (17-136 tok/s) mix queueing and cache hits. Prefix cache hit rate 54% is the arm's real reuse number. The strata-era read-rate convention (900-1025 tok/s non-reused) is history.
measured._concurrency_comment: Moot at one rail: there is no second rail to measure. Kept null so no concurrent-throughput claim survives from the 2-rail era.

routing._comment: Route through the anthropic-proxy, NOT the strata port directly — the proxy applies the tool/finalize guardrails and, via this profile, the per-session context window that clients size their history to. Clients select this profile with the header 'x-uap-model-profile: qwen38' (or a uap_model_profile body param).
